title: Value function v1 numbers from the sealed M180 game, with the H4/H5 sensitivity gates

cost_model.form: cost(c) = width(c) x 345 (head matmul MACs; encode excluded per M104 limitation iv)
cost_model.cost_ref_rule: lowest cost among registered singleton arms whose accuracy is at-or-above c's accuracy

delta_accuracy.form: LOO marginal from the grand coalition (the spec's primary; Shapley as fallback — H2 showed both stable, so LOO is used)

bloat.kind: synthetic wide-weak arm: pool's LOO marginal at spm's width (a bloat copy that adds pool's little bit at spm's cost)

axis_opener.kind: synthetic task-axis-unlocking arm with LOW accuracy (marginal 0.005) on a NEW axis

redundant.kind: the measured spm singleton (highest marginal on the EXISTING axis)

h5_pair.consequence_if_fail: the bonus rises, not the formula

security_constraint.note: V is computed only from validator-replayed sealed measurements; the synthetic gate fixtures are disclosed as synthetic (the H-gate instrument discipline)
